title: SDLC in 6 steps: where DevOps fits #shorts #devops
description:
Every app goes through 6 SDLC phases: plan, define, design, build, test, deploy. DevOps runs them as a fast loop and shifts tests left, so a bug costs 5 minutes, not a weekend.

Full lesson: "SDLC in 6 Steps: Where DevOps Fits | DevOps & SRE Zero to Hero Day 3" on the Tech-dev channel.
